email.gist: Warm-but-brisk. Name-opener, business in a few short lines (often as questions), close with thanks, sign JAF.
do: Salutation 'FirstName -' (spaced hyphen), or dive straight in on a quick reply.
Spaced hyphen as the connective dash everywhere; em-dash never.
Short punchy sentences; frequent direct questions; frame asks AS questions, not orders.
One warm beat; ~one exclamation max; occasional '...' trail-off.
Contract when warm; spell out ('I am', 'do not') when firm.
Sign 'Best'/'Thanks' + JAF (or 'James', or 'James and Day' joint).

technical.gist: Precise, structured, impersonal - the INVERSE of the essay voice.
do: Front-load and roadmap (abstract states method+result; 'First... Then...').
Numbered sections, tables, equations; build by orderly comparison.
Passive/third-person for results, 'we' for method steps, never 'I'.
Name the mechanism precisely; hedge honestly ('may', 'comes close', 'the best that could be').
Cite by number; semicolons OK here.
